r.notes: Another one spotted after another 10 minutes of riding, a singular one clinging to a eucalyptus tree in a much more narrow stretch of habitat, bordering a nearby farm.
A mother with her baby clinging on to her high up a eucalyptus tree on the Brisbane Valley Rail Trail near Mount Hallen
